name: portfolio-analyser-setup
title_zh: 插件装完只差这一步：连上本地应用并排好定时任务
tagline_zh: 装好 Portfolio Analyser 插件后，不用再手动开应用、点刷新。它帮你安全配对本地端口。
tagline_en: After installing the plugin, skip the manual app-launch-and-refresh dance. It securely pairs the local port and.
desc_en: Securely connect the installed Portfolio Analyser plugin to the local app and configure recurring jobs for all research and briefing skills. Use when the user asks to set up, connect, prepare, schedule, or automate the plugin in Codex or Claude Code; do not use to run reports immediately or install the app itself.
why_zh: 它把「连接」和「调度」做成一次性配置，而不是每次重复操作。安全握手走本地回环，密钥不落盘。
why_en: Turns connect-and-schedule into a one-time setup, not a daily ritual. Local loopback handshake keeps keys off disk; cron jobs.
limit_zh: 只负责配置已装好的插件，不替你安装应用本身，也不直接产出报告。若插件未装或端口被占用。
limit_en: Configures an already-installed plugin only—no app installation, no report generation. If the plugin is missing or the port is busy, it stops and.
title_en: Connect the plugin to your local app and schedule.
